questions.question: When is indexing mentioned?
questions.answer: Indexing is discussed in the video "Multi-Tenant RAG with Qdrant | Free AI Engineer Course | 8 Weeks" between timestamps 24:26 and 27:07 [1]. In this section, indexing is described as happening when points are inserted, which tells Qdrant to remember beforehand which vectors belong to specific payload values (such as categories or active statuses) for easier searching [1]. It is mentioned again at timestamp 36:12, noting that indexes must be pre-created for fields like company before using them in filters [2].

questions.question: When is chunk overlap mentioned?
questions.answer: Chunk overlap is first discussed during recursive chunking (17:26 - 20:05), where it is explained as taking trailing words from a previous chunk and including them in the next chunk to preserve context when a sentence gets split [1]. It is mentioned again later (26:44) as a specific parameter—alongside chunk size—that can be set during recursive chunking, such as defining a 20-character overlap [2].

questions.question: When is faithfulness mentioned?
questions.answer: Faithfulness is mentioned during a discussion on RAG evaluation, specifically regarding LLM performance [1]. An LLM is considered not faithful when it answers based on its own prior understanding instead of reading the provided context, which indicates it is hallucinating [1]. To address this, system prompts should be updated to explicitly instruct the model not to hallucinate [1].
